global.criterion: Clearly sculpted compact 3D CARTOON educational diorama on warm off-white with believable metal, soil, wood and plastic material texture and generous margins; not a photoreal scene or flat drawing.
No words, letters, numbers, arrows, logos, emblems, labels, watermark or pseudo-writing on any surface.
No human, hand, face, toy character or visible operation; the tools are separate stationary teaching props on a clean table.

s1-04-tool-layout-still.criterion: A clearly hollow straight sampling push tube, separate spiral hand auger, flat spade and small hand trowel are all complete and visibly different; the probe is not a solid rod and the auger is not an undisturbed core tube.
A narrow probe portion and separate thin even vertical spade slice are visible without implying a full shovel load or that ordinary augering preserves undisturbed soil structure.
A clearly plastic clean empty mixing bucket is present and separate from the soil portions; there is no galvanized bucket or residue.
No tool is depicted contacting underground utilities, being forced into the field or as a universal instruction for every soil and laboratory method.

s1-04-representation-still.criterion: One yellow/stunted and one healthy area contain the same crop type and remain visibly separate, with no illustrated conclusion that a nutrient deficiency or fertilizer choice caused the contrast.
Several small soil portions are distributed within each defined zone and its separate bowl/bag; the two zones' samples are not mixed together.
A single isolated convenient gate-side plug is visibly separate from the distributed within-zone portions, without implying a universal subsample count or depth.
An overhead spatial model shows two zones and their sample relationships, rather than a field-level video frame or a photoreal scene.

s1-04-contamination-still.criterion: Clean empty plastic bucket on one side and a distinct galvanized metal bucket with plausible coating wear on the other side, without implying all metal tools are forbidden.
Old fertilizer granules near the metal bucket and soil in a different probe groove show plausible carryover paths; the clean station remains visibly uncontaminated.
A separate clean new-area station or blank bag is present without contact with the worn bucket or dirty probe; no unsafe or unapproved chemical cleaning is depicted.
Static controlled side-by-side comparison, unlike a sequential eye-level cleaning demonstration, with no text, arrows, logos or person.
